rows: All surfaces should be cleaned by using brushes and air dry compressor

Clean the all surfaces by using cleaning fluids such as freon - TF, 
 chlorothene
Paint the all surfaces of the core if it needed.

Inspect the ends of the armature winding for deposits of oil and evidence
 of corona discharge
Inspect the winding and insulation care fully.
Clean the out surface of all component by using clothes, brushes

تنظيف جميع الأجزاء 
 باستخدام منفاخ الهواء
All contactors and relays should be inspected

The automatic and manual regulator voltage adjuster contact brushes
 should be inspected
Check all screw type connections regularly

Brush Rigging and Collector Rings 
تقتيش

The collector brush rigging should be cleaned 
 by using brushes air blower

Check the side clearance between brush 
 and brushes holder

Inspect all nuts bolts and capscrews for 
 tightness

Check the clearance between brush holder and 
 collector ring

Check the brush wear brush tap 
 at least 1/8" above top of brush box
Remove the brushes from their holders

Clean brush and holder so brush may move 
 freely
قم بتنظيف جهات اتصال مشبك الفرشاة

Use a soft brush seating stone or a canvas - 
 padded bort to remove excess film from shaft

Replace brushes before the pigtail is in 
 contact with top of brush box
Check the connection of wiring of board

Check the Calibration of the temperature 
 meter

Test resistance of all resistance temperature 
 detectors ( R.T.D ) it should be 11.73 W
